name: Speed Run Race
desc:
Welcome to Speed Run Race!
Use treadmills to gain speed! Reach the finish line in under 2 minutes to earn wins and multiply more speed from treadmills!

New Updates Every Week!
💡 How To Play:
- Use treadmills to go faster 👟
- Earn wins to get more speed 🏆
- Get in the Leaderboards 🌍

🌟 Premium player benefits a bonus of +2 WINS!
